text: Vex feels smoother to play this patch. Getting out after a dive is easier.
Brannoc is fine but my team never stays near me so the shield does not do much.
Lyra still feels okay. Hush is underrated.
Okoro is in a good spot. Strong if your team peels for you.
Glad they fixed Ember Lance. It was so annoying when it went through people.
Ashfield is fun for holding objectives.
I keep getting caught as Okoro. Tumble cooldown feels long.
Vex is fine. Good players can punish her with crowd control.
Earthbreaker cone is hard to aim but feels good when it lands.
Lyra is completely broken right now, her healing is way too strong.
Tried Quill in the test queue. Traps are cool, hard to tell if she is strong yet.
